recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, low-angle shot of a chrome semi-truck centered on a desert road, featuring a person standing on the hood against a dual-toned sky transitioning from a fiery orange sunset to a deep blue starry night.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry established by the truck's grille and exhaust stacks.
Contrast between the warm orange horizon and the cool, dark starry sky.
Reflective chrome surfaces mirroring the ambient environmental light.
Human figure acting as a vertical extension of the truck's central axis.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the truck.
High-contrast lighting with glowing amber marker lights.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The truck occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally; the human figure stands atop the engine block, reaching the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vertical chrome grille and the row of amber lights on the bottom bumper.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright bumper lights, moves up the chrome grille to the human figure, then radiates outward to the starry sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides negative space on the left and right, framing the verticality of the truck.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Midnight blue and black (starry upper sky).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the horizon; high value in the chrome highlights and stars.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for functional labeling within the scene.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of the license plate text.
Provides a clean, industrial look suitable for vehicle labeling.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle, symmetrical shot of a chrome semi-truck on a desert road at twilight. The sky should be a gradient of fiery orange at the horizon transitioning into a dark blue sky filled with stars. A person in a brown coat stands on the hood. The truck has glowing amber lights on the bumper.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small yellow license plate to the center of the bottom bumper with bold, condensed black sans-serif text. Add a standard parental advisory label in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Does the sky transition from orange to starry blue?
Are the chrome reflections consistent with the sky colors?

adjustableVariables: Density of the stars in the sky
Clothing style of the person on the truck
Presence of utility poles on the left
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the truck grille
Exact text on the license plate
Specific facial features of the person

mustAchieve: Vibrant color contrast between sky zones

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the amber lights have a visible glow effect.
Verify the person is positioned centrally on the hood.
Confirm the horizon line is low in the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical vehicle + Low-angle perspective + Dual-tone sky (Sunset/Stars) + Central human figure.
